pages.text: Akaishi crystals spawn as ore clusters in the Overworld (stone/deepslate), the Nether, and the End — its shadow reaches the very edge of the universe.$(br)Clusters come in 4 concentrations: flawless, low, medium, perfect. The richer the concentration, the fatter the drop per swing.

$(2,4)Concentration = yield$(0): concentration decides how many crystals drop per break. Don't frown at the count — slap Fortune on your pickaxe to boost it further.$(br2)$(2,4)Want to count money while lying down?$(0)Remember two names: Catalyst + Collector. Together they make crystal farming fully automatic. The full play is in the "Advanced Industry" chapter.
